_meta.description: Illustration provenance manifest. Each entry binds a deterministic asset (TikZ / SVG / matplotlib redraw) to a list of inputs (each hashed) that the image model received during draft exploration. The certificate trusts only the deterministic redraw. Edits to any input invalidate the asset's certificate until re-authored.
_meta.claim_scope_default: schematic illustration only; not empirical evidence
_meta.schema: Each entry has inputs[]: a list of {kind, file, [line_start, line_end], hash}. kind is 'latex_block' (extracted by line range from a paper file) or 'text_file' (whole-file content). The image model receives all inputs concatenated. Adding more inputs adds more constraints on the model's draft.
